about.title: Design thinking shaped by real Amazon work.
paragraphs: I’m Muhammad Ahsan Khan, an Amazon-focused visual designer working across listing images, A+ Content, Premium A+ and Storefront design.

My approach combines strong visual presentation with marketplace awareness: what shoppers see first, what needs explanation, what creates trust, and how the complete listing should feel as one system rather than separate graphics.
